summary: 23 juin 10h update: KOSPI CIRCUIT BREAKER -10% (Samsung -11%, SK Hynix -12%) — global semi selloff + Iran-Hormuz. Nikkei -3.5%, HSI -1.8%. Europe down 1-1.5%. Regime early risk-off dominant (40.9%). MU earnings tomorrow = narrative test. BNP.PA hits 52W high. PCE + Russell Recon Friday.

risks.label: KOSPI circuit breaker — -10% crash, global semi selloff
risks.detail: KOSPI plunged -10% triggering circuit breaker. Samsung -11.17%, SK Hynix -11.78%, Hyundai -12.05%, Kia -8.85%. Combination of semiconductor selloff (global overcapacity fears) and Iran-Hormuz escalation. Contagion: Nikkei -3.5%, HSI -1.8%, EU Stoxx50 -1.5%, ASML -5%. US pre-market futures down. MU earnings tomorrow = next catalyst for semi narrative resolution.

risks.label: Iran-Hormuz standoff — third day, oil markets calling bluff
risks.detail: Iran declared Strait closed Saturday but Oman corridor still open. Brent actually fell -0.46% to $77.54 — market pricing negotiation tactic. If physical blockade occurs: Brent $95-100+ immediately. MOU window still active. VP Vance talks produced no breakthrough.

risks.label: 10-Year yield at 4.509% — approaching 4.60% threshold
risks.detail: Yields rose +5.8bps Monday. 30Y at 4.947% flirting with 5%. Bear steepening signals growth-inflation collision. If 10Y crosses 4.60%: accelerated tech rotation, REIT/utility pressure, EM stress. Warsh-era hawkishness settling in.

risks.label: MU earnings binary risk — Wednesday AMC
risks.detail: MU surged +6.82% to ATH $1,211.38, now $1.37T market cap. Forward P/E 10.0x, 62% above 50D MA — extremely extended. EPS est $19.61. A miss could send MU -10%+ and drag NVDA, ASML, MRVL. Supercycle narrative proof point.

risks.label: PCE Inflation Friday — Fed's preferred gauge
risks.detail: May PCE drops Friday June 27. After Warsh's hawkish FOMC with 9/18 officials signaling hike, a hot PCE print could push 10Y past 4.60% and dollar past 102. Coincides with Russell Reconstitution creating a volatile Friday.

risks.label: Crisis probability doubled to 16.8%
risks.detail: Regime model: crisis probability jumped from 7.5% to 16.8% in one session. Risk_on confidence only 31.3%. Neutral dominates at 31.3% but early_risk_off at 30.4% is nearly equal. Expected 5-day drawdown 4.3%.

risks.label: MSFT in freefall — RSI 30.9, -33.9% from 52W high
risks.detail: MSFT crashed -3.18% to $367.34. Below 50D ($412.86) and 200D ($450.66). MACD at -10.44. Worst drawdown for a $2.7T company in recent memory. If MSFT breaks $356 (52W low), could trigger forced selling.

events.label: FedEx earnings today (Tuesday AMC)
events.detail: First post-Freight-spinoff results as pure-play express delivery. EPS est $5.90. Bellwether for global trade volumes and consumer spending. FDX closed at $328.78 (+1.17%).

events.label: Micron earnings Wednesday AMC — supercycle test
events.detail: MU at ATH $1,211, $1.37T market cap. EPS est $19.61. HBM guidance is the key metric. Determines the AI semiconductor narrative for Q3.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution Friday June 27
events.detail: Annual index rebalance creates massive forced buying. IWM at $298.18, just $1.31 from 52W high. 237 additions to Russell 2000. Expect highest-volume day of the year.

events.label: PCE Inflation + Russell Recon = volatile Friday
events.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge drops same day as the year's biggest index rebalance. Two high-impact catalysts colliding. Position sizing should account for Friday gamma.

events.label: UK PM Starmer resignation watch continues
events.detail: No resignation announcement Monday. Andy Burnham faction still pushing. GBP/USD steady at 1.3237. Market treating it as noise. FTSE rallied +0.72% regardless.

opportunities.detail: IWM at $298.18, just 0.4% from ATH. RSI 62.6. Russell Reconstitution Friday adds structural bid. Rotation from mega-cap tech providing persistent flow. Entry $298.50, stop $289, TP1 $310.

opportunities.label: MSFT — Contrarian mean reversion at RSI 30.9
opportunities.detail: $2.7T company deeply oversold at $367.34, -33.9% from 52W high. Revenue growing 15%+ YoY. High risk/high reward contrarian play. Entry $365-370, stop $352, TP $400. Half size.

opportunities.label: MU post-earnings play — if guidance strong
opportunities.detail: Only if MU beats + raises HBM guidance Wednesday. Forward P/E 10.0x cheap for supercycle name. Not an entry before earnings — too binary. Watch for post-report setup Thursday morning.

regime_blips.label: Tech-to-Small-cap rotation intensifying
regime_blips.detail: IWM +0.88% vs Nasdaq -1.32% Monday. IWM/QQQ ratio surged +1.24% in one day — equivalent to 3 months of average movement. Rotation driven by rising yields + valuation rebalancing + breadth expansion.

regime_blips.label: Semiconductor supercycle narrative at peak tension

regime_blips.label: Bond market bear steepening — yields rising across curve
regime_blips.detail: 10Y +5.8bps to 4.509%, 30Y +4.6bps to 4.947%. Bear steepening (long rates rising faster) signals growth-inflation collision. Warsh-era hawkishness becoming structural, not temporary.

regime_blips.label: Precious metals under pressure — silver -4.11%
regime_blips.detail: Silver crashed -4.11%, gold -1.17%. Rising real rates + strong dollar crushing non-yielding assets. GLD RSI 36.9 approaching oversold. If gold holds $4,100, potential bounce. But trend is down.
